notes: v32 is a local identity-only candidate. It preserves the complete source accounting and does not contain prices, offers, stock, availability, credentials, or production activation.
Reviewed bare-query projection keeps rice grain, shell eggs, fresh strawberry, and mango fruit in the initial table while exposing observed alternative forms through stable clarification predicates.

Clarification choices now carry stable family:form selection IDs end to end through the HTML bridge, Android coordinator, backend request and catalog filter; the previous silent six-choice cap is replaced by a bounded 30-choice contract.
Known contextual families remain literal-searchable and are reachable through explicit observed form choices. Counts are distinct provider products and source identities, not offer or savings claims.
Provider-group metrics are calculated per identity group using logical coverage; they are not semantic completion. TYPE_UNRESOLVED identities remain an explicit review queue.
A specific reviewed type/form alias now wins over a broad same-phrase department alias during cross-language fallback; rice and arroz agree in both language modes.

Bounded predicate, broad-posting, literal-posting, and bare-family caches preserve the real sidecar membership and clarification output while reducing representative warm query p95 to approximately 34–86 ms on this Windows development host.

The optimized v32 refresh candidate was rebuilt from the pinned source in 781.254 seconds, parity-checked against the prior qualified sidecar across 18 English/Spanish queries and full pagination with zero differences, then atomically promoted. The prior sidecar is preserved locally as product-discovery-v2-v32.sqlite.
The promoted sidecar includes identity_alias_identity_idx for identity-scoped lookups; structural counts and source/rules identifiers remain unchanged.

Large candidate sets now use a bounded temporary candidate table instead of SQLite bind-variable lists, with indexed first-page reads, cached product counts, and a bounded page cache. This removes the failure seen when a search expands beyond SQLite's variable limit.

Direct candidate-set stress against the promoted sidecar passed for 100,000 and 250,000 candidate IDs with warm first-page query p95 below 1 ms; this is query-path evidence, not a full synthetic compiler semantic evaluation.

The debug HTML preview is now wired to the typed /v2/search discovery rail with language and stable predicate IDs; the production MainActivity remains on /v1/search. Unauthorized Android status still blocks the v2 request, and no App Check or credential gate was bypassed.

Local v2 route checks against the promoted sidecar returned rice/arroz at 119 products, 247 source identities and 3 choices, and eggs at 222 products, 288 source identities and 7 choices. This is local backend evidence, not remote live authorization or Motorola runtime evidence.

Clarification facet cursors now reach every observed choice page through the native coordinator and HTML bridge, including a valid final page with one choice; the opaque cursor never crosses into JavaScript.

Independent real-sidecar concept audit passed across 274 concepts in both languages: 548 paginated queries, 144 facet pages, 2,678 stable choices and 2,678 strict-selection count checks with zero failures.
v39 is the current local identity-only candidate. It preserves the complete source accounting and does not contain prices, offers, stock, availability, credentials, or production activation.

v39 applies shared, replayable context rules rather than per-product manual edits: stale derived form assertions are replaced, food names containing cream/crema stay out of cosmetics, rice and egg abbreviation/context exclusions are applied, and reviewed English/Spanish rice-cake and whole-egg aliases are indexed.

The v39 semantic refresh intentionally narrows rice from 119 to 115 provider products and eggs from 222 to 204 by removing reviewed false positives; representative strawberry, mango, carrot, fruit, cloth and yerba memberships remain unchanged.

The independent v39 concept audit passed across 274 concepts in both languages: 548 paginated queries, 142 facet pages, 2,666 stable choices and 2,666 strict-selection count checks with zero failures.
The prior promoted sidecar is preserved locally as product-discovery-v2-pre-v39.sqlite with SHA-256 a7d9a061e8bf18cbbd5f588bc608369d7e52ce0dffb7646a5061e5288ae5965b.
